items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the thing like I did with Kevin Kline just recently on, French Kiss.

ctx.x: Well, so then why are rock ‘n’ roll soundtracks so popular with movies now?

Well, it’s certainly terrible cinematic and also I’m discovering that more and more that the kids that are making movies now for the most part don’t know what they’re doing, there’s no taste there and they’re interested in – I’m trying not to sound like an old fogey, but the emphasis is more on the soundtrack album really than it is on helping the picture a great deal. Occasionally you get movies where it works nicely like, Sleepless in Seattle, it’s nice to see a main title and see like – hear Jimmy Durante…
